newsitem.title: USA: Thermo Electron debt rating raised.
newsitem.headline: Thermo Electron debt rating raised.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Tuesday it raised the senior debt rating of Thermo Electron Corp and its principal subsidiaries to single-A from single-A-minus.
Surbordinated debt was raised to single-A-minus from triple-B-plus, the rating agency said, adding that $1.4 billion of debt was affected by the rating actions.
The ratings upgrade reflects continued strengthening of the company's financial profile as it completes another year of solid earnings gains and improving cash flow, Duff & Phelps said.
